purpose: Evidence log for the four remaining missing-interest profiles. Review-only; not a list of enabled destinations.

enabled_update.activity: Urban birdwatching during public park hours
enabled_update.limits: No promised bird species, no zoo/eagle encounter, no research-only morning access, no invented tour duration. Existing free admission, coordinates, hours and accreditation retained.

remaining_profiles.requirement: Actual accessible beach within the unchanged 5 km origin radius; a pool or coastal road is not a substitute.

candidates_not_enabled.name: Times Beach
candidates_not_enabled.reason: Current access to a usable beach could not be established. A Nominatim quarter centroid is not a beach entrance. A Philippine Reclamation Authority ocular report describes the former bathing area as lost; the city confirms the coastal road as an exercise/recreation route. Do not turn the road or neighborhood into an invented beach stop.

candidates_not_enabled.name: Felis Resort Complex
candidates_not_enabled.reason: Recent mirrored operator posts support an operating seaside resort, but do not establish a currently usable beach. An earlier first-person account describes reclaimed frontage and pool swimming. Seaside dining and a pool do not prove the requested beach activity.

candidates_not_enabled.name: Waterworld Davao
candidates_not_enabled.reason: Current mirrored operator beach information exists, but mapped property at approximately 7.0306,125.5279 is outside both downtown profiles' 5 km limit. Do not change the origin or distance preference to make it eligible.

candidates_not_enabled.name: Gumamela Caverock Farm Resort
candidates_not_enabled.reason: Mapped resort in Matina Biao is a promising nearby candidate. A participant's September 2025 event bulletin supports resort use, but the detailed cave/forest trekking accounts located are from 2011-2016. Current permission for that hiking programme, trail access, full duration and guide conditions remain unverified. A resort event does not verify a hiking product.

candidates_not_enabled.name: Green Mountain View, Magtuod/Waan
candidates_not_enabled.reason: Older hiking recommendations conflict with current mapped opening_hours=closed and visitor closure reports. Not enabled.

candidates_not_enabled.name: Viper Peak via Lantaw Banud
candidates_not_enabled.reason: A recent first-person guide describes a real hike and fencing restrictions, but mapped Banud access is farther west than an assumed Toril-center point. No verified road-access point inside this profile's range was established. Do not use a convenient town centroid or summit as its road-routing point.
